name: ratios
inputs_note: the compustat_std stage is a parameter (--std-stage); task 5 rebuilds on the v11-based stage. Reads <std stage>/{fundq,funda}.parquet, market/shares_daily/year=*/shares_daily.parquet, prices/year=*/prices.parquet, corporate_actions/vendor_events.parquet, identity/link_table_v3.parquet, calendar.parquet; validation also reads panel/ (member_equity, characteristic inputs) and universe/ when it has a manifest
staleness: quarterly-based values NULL when session - datadate > 400 days (550 for 20-F/40-F filers); annual-based values when session - FY0 datadate > 550 days

outputs.doc: WFRS-analog ratios (66) and composite scores (Piotroski F, Altman Z, Ohlson O, Beneish M) per common line at each month-end session; fundamentals with available_at < 22:00 UTC of the month-end session, shares and raw close of that session; available_at = 22:00 UTC of the session
issuer fundamental state vintages (TTM flows, balances, averages, annual history, price-free ratios); the latest row with available_at < cutoff is the issuer's state at the cutoff
issuer split / reverse-split events (vendor corporate actions of the issuer's common lines) with the cumulative log ratio; puts per-share EPS on one share basis

asof_macros.ratios_asof: generated: ratios.macros_sql(<root>) -- CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO ratios_asof(d) AS TABLE <the monthly SELECT for the single session d with the fundamentals cutoff 22:00 UTC of the previous calendar session>; the full SQL is stored in ratios/manifest.json (macro_sql)

asof_note: ratios_asof(d): daily as-of view for session d (DATE): fund_state row with available_at < 22:00 UTC of the previous calendar session (GC1 daily), shares_daily.shrout and raw close of d, issuer splits between the state's date and d. Same columns as ratios_monthly. The monthly table uses the GC1 monthly cutoff (22:00 UTC of the month-end session itself).
